title: 第2254章 修补阵法第2253章 天罡破阵纹
content_zh:
“事先说好，我没有绝对的把握能够修补好那阵法。”叶无尘提前开口道，他可不想因为自己到时候没有修补好这阵法，这小丫头缠着自己。
“放心吧，不管有没有修好，我都给你五百上品灵晶作为报酬。”洛云汐拍了拍她那平整的胸脯道。
“五百上品灵晶？”
叶无尘的脚步微微一顿，转头看向身旁这个只到自己胸口的小丫头，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
“怎么样？不少吧？”洛云汐扬起下巴，一脸得意，“只要你帮我把这巨锤修好，五百上品灵晶，一分都不会少你的！”
叶无尘沉默了片刻，缓缓开口：“先看看能不能修好吧，钱的事，修好了再说。”
“好！”洛云汐用力点头，领着叶无尘穿过藏经阁前的广场，沿着一条青石小路向宗门深处走去。
两人走了约莫一刻钟，眼前出现了一片幽静的院落。
“到了！”洛云汐推开院门，蹦蹦跳跳地走了进去，“这里是我住的地方，平时没什么人来，很安静，你可以在这里安心修补阵法。”
叶无尘踏入院中，目光扫过四周，不由得微微挑眉。
这院落虽小，但布置却极为考究，院中的灵植每一株都是珍品，空气中弥漫着浓郁的灵气，甚至比青玄山脉深处还要浓郁几分。
“别愣着了，快进来！”洛云汐已经走进了屋子，回头朝他招手。
叶无尘摇了摇头，迈步跟了进去。
“你就在这里修吧。”洛云汐说着，那柄巨锤被他从储物戒拿了出来，巨大的重量使得脚下的地面都颤了颤。
叶无尘看着身前的巨锤，神魂之力缓缓绽放。
“倒是有些挑战性。”叶无尘轻声开口，眼中闪过一丝兴致。
他闭上眼睛，脑海中浮现出天工圣帝关于天罡破阵纹的所有记载，那些古老的文字在他脑海中一一浮现，每一个字符都蕴含着玄妙的灵纹之道。
约莫一炷香后，他睁开眼睛，眸中闪过一丝明悟。
这种灵纹的刻画手法虽然复杂，但原理并不算太难理解，只是需要极为精细的掌控力和对灵纹之道的深刻理解。
“先看看损坏程度。”叶无尘伸手在锤身上轻轻抚过，指尖处隐隐有灵光流转。

他的神魂之力沿着锤身上的灵纹缓缓扫过，感知着每一道灵纹的状态。
片刻后，他收回了手，眉头微微皱起，这阵法的损坏程度比他想象的还要严重。
锤身上的天罡破阵纹共有三百六十道，如今断裂的足足有两百多道，几乎覆盖了整个阵法。
“怎么样？能修吗？”洛云汐端着一杯茶走了进来，小心翼翼地问道，那双灵动的眸子中满是紧张。
“能修。”叶无尘点了点头，使得洛云汐瞬间双眼放光。
“真的么，真的么，你真的能修好么？”
叶无尘没有理会身旁少女的叽叽喳喳，他的指尖处一缕灵光凝聚，开始在锤身上轻轻勾画。
他打算将这阵法重新改造一番，让它的承受极限大幅提升，否则就算这次修好了，怕是用不了多久还会坏。
时间缓缓流逝，叶无尘全神贯注地修补着锤身上的灵纹，每一笔都极为谨慎，不过一个时辰，他的额头上便渗出了细密的汗珠，但脸上的神色却依旧认真，手中的动作没有丝毫停顿。
洛云汐蹲在一旁，双手托腮，目不转睛地盯着叶无尘的动作。
那双灵动的眸子中，最初的好奇渐渐变成了惊讶，惊讶又变成了敬佩。
“这家伙果然厉害。”她在心中暗暗道。
她虽然不懂灵纹，但她见过不少灵纹师修补兵器，包括那位赵大师。
然而那些人的手法，都没有叶无尘这般行云流水。
约莫过了三个个时辰，叶无尘终于停下了手中的动作，长长地吐出一口浊气。
“好了。”
“好了？”洛云汐眼睛一亮，连忙凑上前去，“让我看看！”
叶无尘侧身让开，洛云汐趴在桌前，瞪大了眼睛盯着锤身上的灵纹。
那些原本断裂黯淡的灵纹，此刻已经重新焕发出了光泽，而且比之前更加璀璨，隐隐有一道道流光在灵纹上流转，美轮美奂。
content_en:
"As promised in advance, I am not absolutely sure that I can repair the formation." Ye Wuchen said in advance. He did not want this little girl to pester him because he had not repaired the formation by then.
"Don't worry, whether it's repaired or not, I will give you five hundred high-grade spiritual crystals as a reward." Luo Yunxi patted her flat chest and said.
"Five hundred high-grade spiritual crystals?"
Ye Wuchen paused for a moment, then turned to look at the little girl next to him who only reached his chest, with a trace of surprise in his eyes.
"How's it going? Quite a lot, right?" Luo Yunxi raised her chin with a proud look on her face, "As long as you help me repair this giant hammer, five hundred high-grade spiritual crystals will not be missing from you at all!"
Ye Wuchen was silent for a moment, then slowly said: "Let's see if it can be fixed first. We'll talk about the money after it's fixed."
"Okay!" Luo Yunxi nodded vigorously and led Ye Wuchen through the square in front of the Sutra Pavilion and walked along a bluestone path towards the depths of the sect.
The two walked for about a quarter of an hour, and a quiet courtyard appeared in front of them.
"We're here!" Luo Yunxi pushed open the courtyard door and jumped in. "This is where I live. Usually no one comes here. It's very quiet. You can safely repair the formation here."
Ye Wuchen stepped into the courtyard, glanced around, and couldn't help but raise his eyebrows slightly.
Although this courtyard is small, its layout is extremely elegant. Every spiritual plant in the courtyard is a treasure. The air is filled with rich spiritual energy, which is even richer than deep in the Qingxuan Mountains.
"Don't be stunned, come in quickly!" Luo Yunxi had already walked into the room and turned back to wave to him.
Ye Wuchen shook his head and followed in.
"You can cultivate it here." Luo Yunxi said, and he took out the giant hammer from the storage ring. The huge weight made the ground under his feet tremble.
Ye Wuchen looked at the giant hammer in front of him, and the power of his soul slowly bloomed.
"It's a bit challenging." Ye Wuchen said softly, with a hint of interest in his eyes.
He closed his eyes, and all the records of the Tiangong Holy Emperor about the Tiangang Breaking Patterns appeared in his mind. Those ancient words appeared in his mind one by one, and each character contained the mysterious way of spiritual patterns.
After about a stick of incense, he opened his eyes, and a glimmer of understanding flashed in his eyes.
Although this method of carving spiritual patterns is complicated, the principle is not too difficult to understand. It just requires extremely fine control and a deep understanding of the way of spiritual patterns.
"Let's take a look at the extent of the damage first." Ye Wuchen stretched out his hand and gently stroked the hammer, and there was a faint light flowing through his fingertips.
The power of his soul slowly swept along the spirit patterns on Hammer's body, sensing the status of each spirit pattern.
After a moment, he withdrew his hand and frowned slightly. The damage to the formation was more serious than he imagined.
There are a total of 360 Tiangang breaking formation patterns on the hammer body, and now there are more than 200 broken formations, covering almost the entire formation.
"How is it? Can it be repaired?" Luo Yunxi walked in with a cup of tea and asked cautiously, her smart eyes full of nervousness.
"It can be repaired." Ye Wuchen nodded, making Luo Yunxi's eyes light up instantly.
"Really, really, can you really fix it?"
Ye Wuchen ignored the chirping of the girl next to him. A ray of spiritual light gathered at his fingertips and began to lightly outline the hammer.
He plans to remodel this formation to greatly increase its endurance limit. Otherwise, even if it is repaired this time, it will probably break down soon.
Time passed slowly, and Ye Wuchen concentrated on repairing the spirit patterns on the hammer, making every stroke with extreme caution. Within an hour, fine beads of sweat began to appear on his forehead, but the look on his face remained serious, and the movements in his hands did not pause at all.
Luo Yunxi squatted aside, holding her chin with her hands, staring intently at Ye Wuchen's movements.
In those smart eyes, the initial curiosity gradually turned into surprise, and the surprise turned intoadmire.
"This guy is really powerful." She thought to herself.
Although she didn't understand spirit patterns, she had seen many spirit pattern masters repairing weapons, including Master Zhao.
However, none of those people's techniques were as smooth as Ye Wuchen's.
After about three hours, Ye Wuchen finally stopped what he was doing and let out a long breath.
"Okay."
"Okay?" Luo Yunxi's eyes lit up and she quickly stepped forward, "Let me see!"
Ye Wuchen stepped aside, and Luo Yunxi lay down in front of the table, staring at the spirit patterns on the hammer with wide eyes.
Those spiritual patterns that were originally broken and dim have regained their luster now, and are even more brilliant than before. There are faint streams of light flowing on the spiritual patterns, which is beautiful.
